newsitem.title: USA: Providence/Wyser-Pratte name nine for COMSAT board.
newsitem.headline: Providence/Wyser-Pratte name nine for COMSAT board.

text.p: Providence Capital Inc, along with Wyser-Pratte & Co Inc, said Thursday that Providence has submitted the names of nine nominees for election to the board of directors at COMSAT Corp.

The two privately-held companies have been named in a lawsuit by COMSAT, charging them with violations of the Communications Satellite Act of 1962 and with acting with a former COMSAT executive to violate his termination agreement.
Twelve directors will be elected at the COMSAT annual meeting, which is scheduled for August 19.
